subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel (portal vs email) and template decision - Vertex Suppliers
messages:
From: Janelle Ortiz <janelle.ortiz@vertexsuppliers.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@vertexsuppliers.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice submission for Redwood - portal or email?

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier. As we’re getting Vertex Suppliers set up in your vendor system, our AP team wants to confirm the preferred invoice submission method and the required invoice fields. A few specifics from our side:

- We typically submit via SFTP-to-portal or via a batch email (accounts-payable@vertexsuppliers.com).
- Our invoices include multiple PO lines per PDF and sometimes a CSV export with line items.
- We need to understand PO stamping rules and whether you require our invoice subject to include your PO number or a token.

Can you confirm:
1) Do you prefer vendors to use the Redwood portal (recommended) or is email fallback required?
2) If email is allowed, what subject/attachment conventions and minimum fields do you enforce?
3) Any sample template we can align to?

Attaching a small sample CSV and our current PDF invoice for reference.

Thanks,
Janelle Ortiz
Vendor Ops Lead | Vertex Suppliers
attachments: vertex_sample_invoice.pdf (pdf), vertex_sample_lines.csv (csv)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Janelle Ortiz <janelle.ortiz@vertexsuppliers.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice submission for Redwood - portal or email?

Hi Janelle — great to hear from you and thanks for the samples. Short answers up front: we prefer the portal for onboarding and long-term submissions (better tracing + faster reconciliations), but we support an email fallback with a strict subject token and a compact CSV when portal access isn’t possible. 

A few clarifying points before we finalize the template:
- Portal: ideal; we can provision API keys for bulk CSV uploads if Vertex wants SFTP -> API connector. Portal gives automatic PO matching for up to 10 line items per PO.
- Email fallback: subject must include Redwood PO token in the form VDW-PO-<PO#> (exact prefix), and attachments should be either a single CSV (preferred) or a single PDF per invoice. Multiple PDFs for the same invoice are acceptable only if they reference the same PO in the subject.
- Required CSV columns we enforce for fallback: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, line_amount, line_description, tax_amount, currency (ISO). Optional: vendor_contact_email, vendor_invoice_id.

I’m attaching a one-page CSV stub and a short portal integration note that explains the PO-stamping behavior. If you’re okay, I’ll loop in Karthik to confirm PO stamping for multi-PO PDFs and Monica to lock the onboarding form fields.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
attachments: vertex_invoice_sample.csv (csv), vertex_portal_integration_notes.pdf (pdf)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel (portal vs email) and template decision - Vertex Suppliers

Forwarding Janelle’s question — note a few risk points:

- Multi-PO PDFs: our portal can reconcile multi-PO if they’re line-itemized and PO numbers are included in the CSV; if Vertex prefers to send a single PDF that contains multiple POs without a line-level CSV, we’ll likely need manual intervention and it will break matching SLAs.
- Currency: ensure they set currency per-line when they have multi-currency shipments; otherwise our finance team rejects.

Suggested ask for the vendor onboarding form:
1) Preferred channel: portal (yes/no) + if yes, preferred method (UI / API / SFTP).
2) If email fallback: confirm exact subject prefix they’ll use and provide a single sample subject line.
3) Attach a one-line sample CSV and indicate whether they’ll include line-level currency and PO lines.

I recommend we default Vertex to portal with email fallback configured (subject token + CSV) for the first 90 days; after that we can remove email fallback if portal adoption is clean. Thoughts?

- Karthik
Head of Procurement Integrations, Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Janelle Ortiz <janelle.ortiz@vertexsuppliers.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Jul 2028 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel (portal vs email) and template decision - Vertex Suppliers

Hi Janelle — thanks for the samples and the quick turnaround. Confirming Redwood’s onboarding stance and the action items so we can update your vendor profile: 

Decision summary (agreed):
- Primary channel: Redwood Vendor Portal (we will send an invite this week). Please use API/SFTP connector if you plan batch nightly uploads.
- Email fallback: supported for the first 90 days during ramp. When emailing, please use the exact subject token: VDW-PO-<PO#> (example: VDW-PO-123456). If you have multiple invoices in one email, each attachment must be a separate CSV or PDF and must include the PO token in the filename as well.
- CSV template (required for email fallback): columns must be invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_number, line_description, quantity, line_unit_price, line_amount, tax_amount, currency
- PO stamping: Our portal will auto-stamp single-PO invoices. For multi-PO PDFs, include line-level CSV (as above) so automatic matching works. Manual reconciliation will be needed if no line-level CSV is present.

Action items:
1) Vertex: Confirm you can produce the required CSV columns and a sample subject line.
2) Redwood (Monica): Send portal invite + onboarding form and sample CSV stub.
3) Redwood (Karthik): Monitor the first 90 days and toggle email fallback off after adoption.

Janelle — if you’re good with this, please reply with a sample subject line and confirm whether you’ll upload via API or SFTP or manual portal UI. We’ll queue the portal invite and onboarding packet once we have confirmation.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Vendor Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: vertex_invoice_sample.csv, onboarding_invite_template.docx
